title: Well.....  it will warm your fingers!
text:
Well..... it will warm your fingers!. This fan is lightweight, easy to use. However, the hot air is not sufficient. It is not strong. You can warm your fingers, but that is about it. Hubby wanted me to use this in my giant garage to work on my business in the winter. I told him...... this can't even warm the kitchen!

The cooling fan is the same..... Pass this!
